query_analysis.original_query: In our solvent recovery system, azeotrope formation is limiting separation efficiency. Would azeotropic distillation or extractive distillation be a better solution?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Evaluate and recommend the most effective distillation technique (azeotropic or extractive) to overcome azeotrope formation and improve solvent recovery system separation efficiency

communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Integrated technique selection and performance validation

clarification_questions: What specific solvents are involved in the azeotrope formation?
What are the current temperature and pressure conditions of your solvent recovery system?
What is the desired purity level for the separated components?
